items.title: 'Thank you, NRL': Titans left scratching heads over fixture
items.description: The Newcastle Knights are at home and can provisionally move into the NRL's top four with a win over the last-placed St George Illawarra Dragons. Follow live.

items.title: Parents accused of starving daughter victims of 'unfair trial', court rules
items.description: The WA Court of Appeal has overturned the guilty verdicts of Perth parents who starved their daughter after ruling that the judge's conduct in the jury trial amounted to a "miscarriage of justice".

items.title: 'I'm going to stay with you': Woman comes to Modra's aid moments after truck crash
items.description: Linda Cameron describes how she rendered first aid to the former Crows player and held his hand as they waited for an ambulance following a truck crash in South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula.

items.title: How Ukraine is breaking through defences to bring war home to Moscow
items.description: Ukraine's growing arsenal of locally produced long-range drones are getting increasingly sophisticated, allowing Kyiv to increasingly strike targets across Moscow.

items.title: Business says Labor's tax changes like a plastic surgery 'freak show'
items.description: Business has labelled Labor's proposed budget tax changes a "freak show", likening them to a celebrity who has had too much plastic surgery.

items.title: Suspected H5 bird flu detected in Australia
items.description: A wild migratory bird in Western Australia has returned a suspected positive result for avian influenza, which has devastated populations of seabirds, seals and other animals across the world.

items.title: From a White House podium, Vance delivers 'stunning development' on Israel
items.description: The US vice-president takes public aim at Israel with a series of comments Washington watchers say are "unprecedented".

items.title: US rebuked over 'climate change' controversy at Antarctic meeting
items.description: The US has been criticised over its reluctance to refer to "climate change" at a major Antarctic meeting, with France describing it as a "dangerous precedent" that risks undermining science.

items.title: Australia's belief has been a long time coming. The United States are wary of it
items.description: When USA coach Mauricio Pochettino was asked about Australia's strengths ahead of the two sides' World Cup meeting in Seattle, he settled on a word — belief.

items.title: Live: Senator accuses KPMG of keeping whistleblower 'quiet'
items.description: KPMG fronts a parliamentary hearing into its dealings with a whistleblower scandal in 2024. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
